steps.en: 2OIC opens the list of notices waiting for endorsement
steps.id: 2OIC membuka daftar notice yang menunggu endorsement
steps.why_en: The screen exists but is hidden from the menu and only shows in the test build.
steps.why_id: Layarnya ada tetapi disembunyikan dari menu dan hanya tampil di build uji coba.

steps.en: 2OIC rejects the decision and adds a remark
steps.why_en: The reject option exists, but nothing limits it to a 2OIC and the screen is hard to reach.
steps.why_id: Pilihan tolak ada, tetapi tidak dibatasi untuk 2OIC dan layarnya sulit dijangkau.

steps.en: The rejection is saved on the notice
steps.why_en: Nothing in the system saves the rejection; the save request from the screen has no receiver.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada bagian sistem yang menyimpan penolakan; permintaan simpan dari layar tidak ada penerimanya.

steps.en: The work item goes back to the officer who decided
steps.id: Work item kembali ke officer yang memutuskan
steps.why_en: Nothing sends the work item back; the list only shows notices by stage, not per officer.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengirim work item kembali; daftar hanya menampilkan notice per stage, bukan per officer.

steps.en: The officer reviews and makes a new decision
steps.id: Officer me-review dan membuat keputusan baru
steps.why_en: The decision form exists but is hidden from the menu and has no working save behind it.
steps.why_id: Form keputusan ada tetapi disembunyikan dari menu dan tidak punya penyimpanan yang berfungsi.
